rail-width.$description: Width of the collapsed sidebar (the 'emoji strip'): 57 px at a 13 px root (D2: was 52). Inside are square buttons of height layout.sidebar.row-height with padding layout.sidebar.padding.

heading-height.$description: Minimum height of a section heading ('Pinned', 'Chats', 'Archive'): 24.7 px (D2: was 21). Larger than the small '+' button in the 'Chats' heading (21 px), so the row does not jump when the button appears.

dot.$description: The 'the trash has entries' dot at the trash icon in the collapsed sidebar (6.5 px).

row-height.$description: Sidebar row height: a chat, 'Trash', the profile (36.4 px, D2: was 32.5 for all list rows).

row-gap.$description: The gap between sidebar rows (2 px, D2: was 3.25).

row-padding.$description: Inner padding of a sidebar row on the left and right (9.1 px, D2: was 6.5). The tile and the section heading stand on one vertical line.

row-content-gap.$description: The gap between the tile and the title in a sidebar row (10.4 px, D2: was 6.5).

section-gap.$description: Space above a sidebar section heading ('Chats' under 'Pinned'): 19.5 px (D2: was 6.5).

width.$description: Width of the 'New chat' / 'Rename' / 'Chat emoji' window (351 px at a 13 px root): narrower than the settings window, the picker inside takes the content width.

top.$description: Offset of the chat window from the top edge: the window is pressed to the top, not centered, so the picker that expands under the field does not shift the title (52 px).
